title: A Global View of How LLMs Value Human Time

bias_targets.methodology: Varying the user's country location in a standardized prompt to measure the monetary compensation the LLM deems appropriate for a 60-minute appointment delay across 193 different countries.

Comparing the LLM-generated monetary compensation for waiting time across different countries against economic indicators like GDP per capita (PPP) and Mean Income to identify systematic overvaluation or undervaluation of a user's time.
